noah: quick check-in: we keep seeing tiny flips when latency vs cost are almost tied for interactive tenants.

tess: noticed it too. simplest fix is a short stability window that prefers previous selection when score_delta < epsilon.

ravi: agree but we must avoid sticking to cold GPUs. proposal: only apply stability if candidate.recent_success == true or warmup_estimate < threshold.

noah: pseudo: if delta < eps and now - last_selected < stability_ms and candidate.warm: choose previous else normal.

tess: add metric selected_reason and route_flip_rate. make tenant override possible (aggressive_cost_savers opt-out).

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: routing-core v1.2.4 -> canary

ravi: will run short sim tonight. if flips drop and p99 latency unchanged we roll.

noah: filing RI-9100 for RFC + results. thanks.
